title: Higher direct image as a sheafified cohomology presheaf
statement:
Let $h:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes and $F\in\Ab(Y_{\Et})$. Then
$R^qh_*F$ is the sheaf associated with the presheaf

$$
(U\to X)\longmapsto H^q\bigl(U\times_XY,F|_{U\times_XY}\bigr)
$$

on $X_{\Et}$; more generally for $K\in\Dplus(Y_{\Et})$ the cohomology sheaf
$R^qh_*K$ is associated with $U\mapsto H^q(U\times_XY,K|_{U\times_XY})$.
(*Stacks Project, Lemma Tag 03Q8.*)

proof.text: Let A(U) be the sheafification of the free abelian presheaf on the representable U. The free-forgetful adjunction, the sheafification adjunction and Yoneda give Hom(A(U),G) = G(U), naturally in both U and G. The exact pullback functor commutes with single complexes; the bounded below derived adjunction therefore identifies the displayed presheaf with U ↦ Hom(A(U)[0], Rh_*(K[q])). This is the Lean isomorphism higherDirectImagePresheafIso, assembled from mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor and Adjunction.derivedPlus.

source.place: Lemma Tag 072W proof; Tag 03Q8 etale specialization; derived-adjunction reformulation of the sectionwise comparison

proof.text: For any bounded below derived object L on X_et, choose a bounded below K-injective representative M. The natural map Hom(A(U)[0],L) → H^0(L)(U) is locally surjective: the epimorphism Z^0(M) → H^0(M) is locally surjective, so a section locally lifts to a cycle; the free-sheaf Hom equivalence turns that cycle into a morphism of complexes A(U)[0] → M. It is locally injective: represent the difference of two maps by a chain map f using K-injectivity. If its cohomology section is zero, its cycle map factors through the kernel of Z^0(M) → H^0(M). The epimorphism from M^{-1} onto this kernel locally lifts that factorization, giving a local b with f^0 = b d^{-1}. The explicitly constructed single-complex homotopy then makes the local derived morphism zero. Naturality transports both properties along Q(M) ≅ L. These arguments are the private local comparison lemmas in the delivered module and use the K-injective fully faithful comparison, not restriction of injectives to U.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0BKV proof, K-injective sectionwise cycles and boundaries; Tag 03Q8

proof.text: A locally injective and locally surjective map P → G from a presheaf to a sheaf induces an isomorphism P^# ≅ G: its adjoint ψ satisfies η_P ≫ ψ = φ, and local surjectivity of η_P transfers local injectivity and local surjectivity to ψ; Mathlib Sheaf.isLocallyBijective_iff_isIso gives invertibility. Apply this to the preceding comparison for L = Rh_*(K[q]), and apply sheafification to the adjunction presheaf isomorphism from the first step. Compose with the shift isomorphisms H^0(Rh_*(K[q])) ≅ H^0((Rh_*K)[q]) ≅ H^q(Rh_*K). The sheaf clause is the specialization K = F[0].
